in_marathi.name: Girdhar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girdhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gir means 'mountain' and Dhar means 'to uphold'. This name is derived from the Hindu God, Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as a cowherd. The name symbolizes strength, power, and devotion.

in_bengali.name: Girdhar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Cows
in_bengali.long_meaning: Girdhar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Gir means 'mountain' and Dhar means 'to uphold'. This name is derived from the Hindu God, Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as a cowherd. The name symbolizes strength, power, and devotion.
